The Cavern Drakensberg Resort & Spa | Family Resort | Drakensberg Accommodation Skip to content Cavern Drakensberg Resort Spa
From a modest homestead in the mountains to a much-loved family resort, The Cavern has remained rooted in the philosophy of its founder:
Our work is to create beauty, to make the land more fertile, to make our living, to leave the world better than when we first came into it ~ Bill Carte, 1941
Today the resort continues that legacy, welcoming generations of returning families who come for the mountains, the people, and the sense of belonging that has defined The Cavern for more than eight decades.
The story of The Cavern began in 1941, when Bill and Ruth Carte arrived in the Northern Drakensberg. Captivated by the beauty of the valley and the towering sandstone cliffs, they began welcoming a few visitors to share in the peace and splendour of this remarkable place.
Those early years were simple. Guests stayed in thatched rondavels, explored the mountains on foot, and gathered in the evenings for sundowners and conversation. After Bill’s passing in 1954, Ruth continued to nurture and grow The Cavern while raising their four children. In time, the next generation joined the journey, expanding the guest farm into the mountain resort it is today while remaining true to the founding values of family, connection, and respect for the land.
More than 80 years later, The Cavern remains proudly family-run by the third generation. While the resort has grown and evolved, the heart of the experience remains unchanged; a place where families reconnect, friendships are formed, and guests return year after year to share in the beauty of the mountains.
For many who visit, it has become what we lovingly call “The Resort of Many Happy Returns”.

Accommodation | The Cavern Drakensberg Resort & Spa Skip to content Accommodation
The Cavern is a Drakensberg holiday resort offering two types of accommodation standard and superior.
Rooms are set in landscaped gardens where a vibrant mix of indigenous plants attracts hundreds of birds that fill the days with birdsong and the evenings with the sounds of crickets, frogs and other friendly creatures. Superior suites overlook an ancient fern forest and each unit has its own private patio where you can relax in the sun, listen to the forest streams and unwind in the peace of untouched mountain wilderness.

About | The Cavern Drakensberg Resort & Spa Skip to content About
Rooted in the Drakensberg since 1941, The Cavern s story is one of family, community and a deep connection to the natural world.
Since 1941, The Cavern has been more than a mountain resort. Built on a foundation of family hospitality, it has grown into a place where people, community and nature are deeply connected. As a founding member of the Northern Drakensberg Nature Reserve, The Cavern is committed to conserving the remarkable landscapes, biodiversity and cultural heritage of this special region. Beyond our borders, we are proud to support education and community development through the Royal Drakensberg Education Trust and a range of local initiatives. Discover the story, values and stewardship that continue to shape life at The Cavern today.
History
Ruth and Bill decided to buy the farm from the judge, recognising its potential as a guest house.
Community
Our Mission is to provide quality educational opportunities in our community.
Conservation
The purposes of the Reserve are to conserve animal species and habitats
